browser_report.role: Existing automated report was read for candidate identity and capture context. This review independently views only the 26 listed images; it does not rerun browser interactions or HTTP checks.

nonblocking_notes: Native browser video controls are visible on paused screenshots and dim the bottom of some long code cards; the return lines remain present and discernible.
Desktop captures are intentionally scrolled to center the player; the page title is partly above the sticky header. The complete player remains visible.

At a 390px viewport the native video image scales to the mobile player; fine diagram text is small. This screenshot review verifies correct loaded content and layout, not a claim that all tiny text is comfortable to read without full screen.

limits: Static browser screenshots in simulated desktop/mobile viewports; not a physical-device test.
No continuous-play manual motion review or full-film listening was performed here.
No production sources, media, existing formal final-review documents, build outputs, or browser report were changed.
No additional build, HTTP sweep, media decoding, or browser interaction run was performed for this image-only review.
